[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
7th November,
2001]
F. No. 2(1)/2001-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Civil Servants
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section 23-A and 23-B Act LXXI of 1973

ORDINANCE LXI OF 2001
ORDINANCE LXI OF
2001
CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
(An Ordinance
further to amend the Civil Servants Act, 1973)
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
7th November,
2001]
F. No. 2(1)/2001-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:
2. Insertion of new sections
23A and 23B Act LXXI of 1973.---In the Civil Servants Act, 1973 (LXXI of
1973), after section 23, the following new sections shall be inserted,
namely:--
"23A. Indemnity.---No
suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against a civil servant
for anything done in his official capacity which is in good faith done or
intended to be done under this Act or the rules, instructions or directions
made or issued thereunder.
23B. Jurisdiction barred.---Save
as provided under this Act and the Service Tribunals Act, 1973 (LXX of 1973),
or the rules made thereunder, no order made or proceedings taken under this
Act, or the rules made thereunder by the President or any officer authorized by
him shall be called in question in any Court and no injunction shall be granted
by any Court in respect of any decision made, or proceedings taken in pursuance
of any power conferred by, or under, this Act or the rules made thereunder.".
